arabic_text: لِأَلِيمِ الْعَذَابِ وَشِدَّتِهِ!
transliteration: li-alīmil-ʿaẓābi wa-shiddatih
english_text: For the pain and severity of chastisement?

arabic_text: أَمْ لِطُولِ الْبَلآءِ وَمُدَّتِهِ!
transliteration: am litọ̄li al-balāʾi wamuddatihi!
english_text: Or for the length and period of tribulation?

arabic_text: فَلَئِن صَيَّرْتَنِي لِلْعُقُوبَاتِ مَعَ أَعْدَآئِكَ وَجَمَعْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِ بَلآئِكَ وَفَرَّقْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَحِبَّائِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى عَذَابِكَ،
transliteration: fa-lain ṣayyartanī lilʿuqūbāt maʿa ʾaʿdāʾika wa-jamʿata bayni wa-bayna ahl-i balāʾika wa-farraqtu bayni wa bayna aḥibba'ika wa awliyā'ika fahabnī yā ilāhī wa sayyidī wa mawlāy wa rabbī, ṣabartu ʿalā ʿadhābika
english_text: So if You take me to the punishments with Your enemies, And gather me with the people of Your tribulation And separate me from Your friends and saints, Then suppose, My God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord that I am able to endure Your chastisement,

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَلَى فِرَاقِكَ
transliteration: fakayfa 'asbiru 'ala firaaqika
english_text: How can I endure separation from You?

arabic_text: وَهَبْنِي صَبَرْتُ عَلَى حَرِّ نَارِكَ، فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
transliteration: wa habnī, ṣabartu ʿalá ḥarri nārik fakayfa 'asbiru 'ani an-nadhari 'ila karamatika
english_text: And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Your fire, How can I endure not gazing upon Your generosity?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجَائِي عَفْوُكَ
transliteration: am kayfa as-kunu fil-naar wa rajaa'i ʿafwuka
english_text: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is Your pardon?

arabic_text: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ أُقْسِمُ صَادِقًا، لَئِنْ تَرَكْتَنِي نَاطِقًا لَأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِهَا ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
transliteration: fabi'izzatika ya sayyidi wa mawlaya uqsimu saadiqan, la'in tarakatani naatiqan la 'adijjanna ilayka bayna ahliha dajiij al-amiliin
english_text: So by Your might, my Master and my protector, I swear sincerely, if You leave me with speech, I will lament to You from the midst of the Fire's inhabitants with lamentation of the hopeful;

arabic_text: وَلأَصْرُخَنَّ إِلَيكَ صُرَاخَ المُسْتَصْرِخِينَ
transliteration: wa la asrukhanna ilayka suraakha al-mustasrikheen
english_text: I will cry to You with the cry of those crying for help;

arabic_text: وَلَأَبْكِيَنَّ عَلَيْكَ بُكَاءَ الفَاقِدِينَ
transliteration: walābakīyanna ʿalayka bukāʾa al-fāqideen
english_text: I will weep to You with the weeping of the bereft;

arabic_text: وَلَأُنَادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَا غَايَةَ آمَاِل العَارِفِينَ يَا غِيَاثَ المُسْتَغِيْثِينَ يَا حَبِيبَ قُلُوبِ الصَّادِقِينَ
transliteration: wa la'unadiyannaka ayna kuntaya waliyya al-mu'mineen yā ghāyat āmāl al-ʿārifīn yā ghīyath al-mustaghithīn yā ḥabība qulūbiṣ-ṣādiqīn
english_text: And I will call to You, Where art Thou, O Sponsor of the believers, O Goal of the hopes of Your knowers, O Aid of those who seek assistance, O Friend of the hearts of the sincere

arabic_text: وَيَا إِلَهَ العَالَمِينَ
transliteration: wa yā ʾilāha al-ʿālamīn
english_text: And O God of all the world's inhabitants!

arabic_text: أَفَتُرَاكَ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا إِلَهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُّسْلِمٍ سُجِنَ فِيهَا بِمُخَالَفَتِهِ وَذَاقَ طَعْمَ عَذَابِهَا بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ وَحُبِسَ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا بِجُرْمِهِ وَجَرِيرَتِهِ
transliteration: "ʾafaturāka, subḥānaka yā ilāhī wa biḥamdik, tasmaʿu fīhā ṣawta ʿabdin muslimin sujina fiha bimukhalafatihi wa dhāqa ṭaʿma ʿadhābihā bi maʿṣiyatihī wa ḥubisa bayna aṭbāqihā bi jurmihi wa jarīratihi
english_text: Can You see Yourself — Glory be to You My God, and Yours is the praise — hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to Imprisoned there because of his violations, Tasting the flavour of its torment because of his disobedience, And confined within its levels because of his sin and crime,

arabic_text: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِّرَحْمَتِكَ وَيُنَادِيكَ بِلِسَانِ أَهْلِ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَيَتَوَسَّلُ إلَيْكَ بِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
transliteration: wa huwa yaḍijju ilayka ḍajīja mujammilin li-raḥmatika wa yunādīka bi lisāni ahlit-tawḥīdik wayatawassalu ilayka bi rububiyyatika
english_text: While he laments to You with the lament of one hopeful for Your mercy, And calls to You with the tongue of those who profess Your Unity And entreats You by Your lordship!

arabic_text: يَا مَوْلايَ فَكَيْفَ يَبْقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ
transliteration: yā mawlāy, fakaīfa yabqā fīl-'adhabi wahūwa yarjū mā salafa min ḥilmika
english_text: My Protector, so how should he remain in the chastisement, while he has hope for Your previous clemency?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَأْمَلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
transliteration: am kayfa tu'lamuhu alnnaru wahua ya'malu fadhlaka warahmatika
english_text: Or how should the Fire cause him pain while he expects Your bounty and mercy?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ
transliteration: am kayfa yuhriquhu lahibuhā wa anta tasmaʿu ṣawtahu wa tara makānahu
english_text: Or how should its flames burn him, while You hear his voice and see his place?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ
transliteration: am kayfa yashtamilu ʿalayhi zafīruhā wa anta taʿlamu ḍaʿfahu
english_text: Or how should its groaning encompass him, while You know his weakness?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ
transliteration: am kayfa yataqallalu bayna aṭbāqihā wa anta taʿlamu ṣidqah
english_text: Or how should he be convulsed among its levels, while You know his sincerity?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ يَا رَبَّهُ
transliteration: amma kayfa tazjuruhu zabaaniyatuhā wa huwa yunādīka yā rabbahu
english_text: Or how should its keepers torture him while he calls out to You, “O Lord”?

arabic_text: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا
transliteration: am kayfa yarju fadlaka fi ʿitqihī minhā fatatrukuhū fīhā
english_text: Or how should he have hope of Your bounty in freeing him from it, while You abandon him within it?

arabic_text: هَيهَاتَ مَا ذَلِكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا الْمَعْرُوفُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَلا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ
transliteration: hayhat mā dhālika al-ẓannu bika wa lā al-maʿrūf min faḍlika walā mushbihun limā ʿāmalta bihi al-muwahhidīna min birrika wa-iḥsānik
english_text: Far be it from You! That is not what is expected of You, Nor what is well-known of Your bounty, Nor it is similar to the goodness and kindness Thou hast shown to those who profess Your Unity.

arabic_text: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ لَوْلا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِن تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ وَقَضَيْتَ بِهِ مِنْ إِخْلاَدِ مُعَانِدِيكَ لَجَعَلْتَ النَّارَ كُلَّهَا بَرْدًا وَّسَلاَمًا، وَمَا كَانَ لأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرًّا وَّلا مُقَامًا
transliteration: fa bil-yaqīni aqṭaʿu lawlā mā ḥakamta bihī min taʿẓībi jāḥidīka waqaḍayta bihi min ikhlādi muʿānidīka lajʿaltan-naara kullaha bardan wa salaaman wamā kāna li-aḥadin fīhā maqarran wallā muqāmān
english_text: So I declare with certainty that were it not for what You have decreed concerning the chastisement of Your deniers And what You have foreordained concerning the everlasting home of those who stubbornly resist, You would make the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety, And no one would have a place of rest or abode within it.

arabic_text: لَّكِنَّكَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ تَمْلَأَهَا مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَأَنْ تُخَلِّدَ فِيهَا الْمُعَانِدِينَ
transliteration: lākinna-ka taqaddasat asmā-uka, aqsamta an tamla'a-hā min al-kāfirīn min al-jinnati wa al-nāsi ajmaʿīna wa ʾan tukhallida fīhā almuʿāndīn
english_text: But You —holy are Your Names—hast sworn that You will fill it with the unbelievers, Both Jinn and men together, And that You will place those who stubbornly resist therein forever.

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِئًا، وَّتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّمًا: أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي فَأَسْألُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا وَبِالْقَضِيَّةِ الَّتِي حَتَمْتَهَا وَحَكَمْتَهَا وَغَلَبْتَ مَنْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرَيْتَهَا
transliteration: wa anta jalla thana'uka qulta mubtadiaan, wa tatawwaltu bil-in'aami mutakarriman afaman kana mu'minan kaman kana fasiquan la yastawun ilāhī wa-sayyidī fa-as'aluka bial-qudrah allatī qaddartahā wa bil-qadīyyah allatī ḥatamta-hā wa ḥakamta-hā wa ghalabta man ʿalay-hi ajraytahā
english_text: And You — majestic is Your eulogy— said at the beginning and were gracious through kindness as a favour, “What? Is he who has been believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal” (32:18) My God and my Master! So I ask You by the power You have apportioned And by the decision which You have determined and imposed and through which You have overcome him toward whom it has been put into

arabic_text: أَن تَهَبَ لِي، فِي هذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ كُلَّ جُرْمٍ أَجْرَمْتُهُ وَكُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ قَبِيحٍ أَسْرَرْتُهُ
transliteration: 'an tahaba li, fī hādhīhi al-laylah, wa fī hādhīhi al-sā'ah kullu jurmin ajramtuhu wa kulla dhanbin adhnabtuhu wa kulla qabīḥin asrartuhu
english_text: That You forgive me in this night and at this hour Every offence I have committed, And every sin I have performed, And every ugly thing I have concealed

arabic_text: وَكُلَّ جَهْلٍ عَمِلْتُهُ، كَتَمْتُهُ أَوْ أَعْلَنتُهُ، أَخفَيْتُهُ أَوْ أَظْهَرْتُهُ وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الكَاتِبِينَ
transliteration: wa kulla jahlin 'amiltuhu katamtu-hu aw aʿlantu-hu akhfaytuhu aw athharthuhu wa kulla sayyiatin amarta bi'ithbatiha al-kirama al-katibin
english_text: And every folly I have enacted Whether I have hidden or announced it, Or I have concealed it or manifested it And every evil act which You have commanded the Noble Writers to record,

arabic_text: الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُم بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي، وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ شُهُودًا عَلَيَّ مَعَ جَوَارِحِي،
transliteration: alladhina wakkaltahum bihifdhi ma yakuunu minni wa jaʿaltahum shuhūdan ʿalayya maʿa jawāriḥī
english_text: Those whom You have appointed to watch over what appears from me And whom You have made, along with my bodily members, witness against me.

arabic_text: وَكُنتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِن وَّرَائِهِمْ، وَالشَّاهِدَ لِمَا خَفِيَ عَنْهُمْ، وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ أَخْفَيْتَهُ، وَبِفَضْلِكَ سَتَرْتَهُ
transliteration: wa kunta anta al-raqība ʿalayya min warāʾihim wal-shāhida limā khafiya 'anhum، wa bi-raḥmatika akhfaytahu wa bifadlika satarthu
english_text: And “You were Yourself the Watcher” (5:117) over me from behind them, And the Witness of what is hidden from them But through Your mercy You concealed it And through Your bounty You veiled it.

arabic_text: وَأَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِن كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُهُ، أَوْ إِحْسَانٍ تُفْضِلُهُ أَوْ بِرٍّ تَنْشُرُهُ، أَوْ رِزْقٍ تَبْسُطُهُ
transliteration: wa an tuwaffira haẓẓī min kulli khayrin tunziluhu aw iḥsānin tufḍiluhu 'aw birrin tanshuruhu aw rizqin tabṣuṭuhu
english_text: [And I ask You] that You bestow upon me an abundant share of every good You send down, Or kindness You confer, Or goodness You unfold, Or provision You spread out,

arabic_text: أَوْ ذَنْبٍ تَغْفِرُهُ أَوْ خَطَأٍ تَسْتُرُهُ
transliteration: ʾaw ẓanbin taghfiruhu aw khata'an tasturu-hu
english_text: Or sin You forgive, Or error You cover.
